assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks accompanied by intermittent palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia.
To evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other rhythm disturbances that may be contributing to these neurologic symptoms, a cardiac event monitoring study is indicated.
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated.
The claims are supported by diagnosis codes I49.9 and G45.9.
I49.9 addresses the cardiac concern underlying this monitoring study.
G45.9 addresses the cerebrovascular concern underlying this monitoring study.
